snippet.title: QBIX Game | AstroRyders Trailer
snippet.description:
AstroRyders is a 1-6 Player risky mission where players solve puzzles to save the world!
It’s a group fun experience enhanced by 3D high-quality graphics, thrilling sounds, motion floor, and wind blasts!

The Game is a thrilling combination of action and puzzle-solving, designed to provide an immersive and unforgettable group experience. Players step into the shoes of a brave AstroRyder and navigate through a series of challenging obstacles and treacherous alien encounters. 

Visit https://inowize.com/qbix/ for the entire QBIX Game Library!
